_comment: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server configuration template
_comment2: Customise for your project. Security rules: prod databases = read-only, dev = read-write.
_comment3: Install instructions: see docs/MCP_CONFIGURATIONS.md for detailed per-server setup
_comment4: Versions pinned on 2026-11-21 (npm packages) and 2026-11-22 (entries that were marked _review: PyPI, Docker, hosted servers). A pinned version does not update itself: before you enable a server, check its current version and its publisher on the registry, then re-pin on purpose. Entries with _source name the page that documents the install form; entries with _review and "_enabled": false have no pinned version or no maintained distribution and stay disabled.

context7._description: Up-to-date SDK docs — prevents API hallucination. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

sequential-thinking._description: Structured chain-of-thought before acting. Improves reasoning quality.

brave-search._description: Authoritative web research with source filtering.
brave-search._review: deprecated on npm; pinned to its last version only so that the entry is reproducible; check it before use. Successor: Brave's own server https://github.com/brave/brave-search-mcp-server (npm @brave/brave-search-mcp-server). Checked 2026-11-22; the npm notice names none.
brave-search._note: Deprecated: npm marks this package 'no longer supported' (checked 2026-10-30); it still installs. Prefer an actively maintained alternative.

filesystem._description: Access local project files for knowledge ingestion (RAG).

github._description: PR review, code search, issue management, git history.
github._review: deprecated on npm; pinned to its last version only so that the entry is reproducible; check it before use. Successor: GitHub's official server https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server (Go binary or Docker image). Checked 2026-11-22; the npm notice names none.
github._note: Deprecated: npm marks this package 'no longer supported' (checked 2026-10-30); it still installs. Prefer an actively maintained alternative.

githits._description: Lets the agent navigate the open-source code your app depends on — search/grep/read dependency source, docs, issues, PRs and changelogs without cloning. Prevents dependency-API hallucination. No API key.
githits._install: Auto-config: `npx githits@0.41.0 init` detects your tool and wires this in. Docs: https://docs.githits.com/installation/automatic-setup (manual: /installation/manual-setup).

postgres-dev._review: deprecated on npm; pinned to its last version only so that the entry is reproducible; check it before use. Successor: DBHub (the `dbhub` entry, https://github.com/bytebase/dbhub), whose README names this package as the one it replaces. Checked 2026-11-22; the npm notice names none.
postgres-dev._note: Deprecated: npm marks this package 'no longer supported' (checked 2026-10-30); it still installs. Prefer an actively maintained alternative.
postgres-dev._security: DEVELOPMENT ONLY — never use read-write in production

greptime._description: Time-series analytics and robust metrics logging.
greptime._note: Official GreptimeDB server on PyPI; the console script has the package name.

clickhouse._description: Agentic OLAP and real-time reporting via ClickHouse.

postgres-prod._description: PostgreSQL for production — READ-ONLY. Schema introspection only.
postgres-prod._review: deprecated on npm; pinned to its last version only so that the entry is reproducible; check it before use. Successor: DBHub (the `dbhub` entry, https://github.com/bytebase/dbhub), whose README names this package as the one it replaces; keep it read-only. Checked 2026-11-22; the npm notice names none.
postgres-prod._note: Deprecated: npm marks this package 'no longer supported' (checked 2026-10-30); it still installs. Prefer an actively maintained alternative.
postgres-prod._security: PRODUCTION — read-only access enforced by database user permissions

semgrep._description: SAST code scanning, security analysis, custom rules.
semgrep._install: Local: pip install semgrep-mcp (Python module), runs via `python -m semgrep_mcp`.

time-complexity._description: Estimates Big-O time & space complexity via static analysis (tree-sitter). No code execution.
time-complexity._security: Static analysis only — read-only file access, no code execution
time-complexity._install: Local GitHub server: git clone the time-complexity-mcp repository, run `npm install && npm run build`, then set args to the built dist/index.js path. Pairs with coding/time-complexity.skill.

sentry._description: Error tracking, bug context, performance issues.

playwright._description: Browser automation for visual TDD and E2E testing.

tavily._description: Real-time web search and content extraction. Use for research.skill.

image-recognition._description: Vision API proxy for image analysis — sketch recognition, diagram interpretation, OCR.
image-recognition._security: Images are sent to configured vision API (Anthropic/OpenAI/Cloudflare) for processing
image-recognition._review: unmaintained community package: PyPI mcp-image-recognition 1.2.2 (2025-03), repository untouched since 2025-04, no official vendor server; checked 2026-11-22; kept for reference, disabled

terraform._description: Agentic Infrastructure as Code (IaC) via HashiCorp Terraform.
terraform._note: Official HashiCorp container image, pinned to a tag.

docker._description: Docker daemon integration — manage containers, images, and read local logs.
docker._note: Docker MCP Toolkit (the `docker mcp` CLI plugin of Docker Desktop).
docker._review: the version is that of the installed Docker Desktop (`docker mcp` plugin), not set here; kept disabled

google-cloud._description: Google Cloud Platform access — manage Firebase, Cloud Run, GKE, BigQuery.

azure._description: Azure Resource management — Key Vault, CosmosDB, Azure Storage.
azure._note: Latest stable release; the npm "latest" tag points to a 4.0.0 beta.

vercel._description: Vercel deployments, aliases, and serverless log integration.
vercel._note: Hosted server with OAuth: run `/mcp` in Claude Code to sign in.

gitlab._review: deprecated on npm; pinned to its last version only so that the entry is reproducible; check it before use. Successor: GitLab's own MCP server https://docs.gitlab.com/user/model_context_protocol/mcp_server/. Checked 2026-11-22; the npm notice names none.
gitlab._note: Deprecated: npm marks this package 'no longer supported' (checked 2026-10-30); it still installs. Prefer an actively maintained alternative.

jira._description: Jira Cloud task interaction — read/update tickets.

notion._description: Notion workspace access — pages, databases, docs.

qdrant._description: Semantic memory layer — vector search for long-term knowledge.

datadog._note: Hosted server. The URL is for the US1 site; other sites use their own URL (see the page). OAuth is the alternative to the two keys.

grafana._description: Dashboard search, datasource queries, incident management.
grafana._note: Official Grafana server; the token is a service account token.

aws-core._description: AWS core services — documentation, CDK, Lambda.
aws-core._note: AWS MCP Server (managed, SigV4 through the AWS proxy). awslabs.core-mcp-server is yanked on PyPI.

kubernetes._description: Cluster state, pod logs, deployment management.

slack._note: Hosted server with OAuth; Slack requires a registered or directory-listed app, see the page.

figma._description: UI/UX semantic understanding, component specs, and design-to-code.
figma._note: Hosted server with OAuth. The desktop server needs the Figma desktop app instead.

drawio._description: Programmatic generation and editing of C4, UML, and Network diagrams in Draw.io.
drawio._note: Official draw.io server. A hosted variant exists at https://mcp.draw.io/mcp.

excalidraw._description: Create and manage Excalidraw diagrams — nodes, edges, and diagram state.

tldraw._description: Persistent visual canvas — create, manage, and search tldraw .tldr files for wireframing and design.

miro._description: Read context from virtual whiteboards and continuously sync architecture PRDs.

mermaid._description: Translate Mermaid/PlantUML text syntax into immediately viewable SVG/PNG images.

dbhub._description: Universal DB client (MySQL, MariaDB, PG, SQL Server).
dbhub._note: Bytebase DBHub. Add `readonly = true` in a TOML `--config` to keep it read-only (see its README).

redis._review: deprecated on npm; pinned to its last version only so that the entry is reproducible; check it before use. Successor: Redis's official server https://github.com/redis/mcp-redis (PyPI redis-mcp-server). Checked 2026-11-22; the npm notice names none.
redis._note: Deprecated: npm marks this package 'no longer supported' (checked 2026-10-30); it still installs. Prefer an actively maintained alternative.

confluence._note: Atlassian hosted server (Jira and Confluence) with OAuth.

linear._description: Linear issue tracking and project management.

sonarqube._note: Official SonarSource image, pinned to a tag.

duckduckgo._note: Community server (no official DuckDuckGo one); maintained, last release 2026-09.

snyk._description: Vulnerability scanning for code and dependencies.
snyk._note: Snyk CLI with its built-in MCP server.

gitleaks._review: no published distribution found on 2026-11-22 (npm search "gitleaks mcp", PyPI gitleaks-mcp, the gitleaks README and the GitHub repository search show no MCP server from gitleaks or a maintained community one); kept for reference

jupyter._description: Execute Python code in Jupyter notebooks.
jupyter._note: Datalayer server (the Jupyter project's MCP server).

stripe._note: Hosted server; OAuth is the default, an agent API key is the alternative (full-access secret keys stop working on 2027-01-11). npm @stripe/mcp is no longer maintained.

graphql._description: GraphQL schema introspection, query validation, and documentation.
graphql._note: Community server (no official generic one); last release 2025-05.

elasticsearch._description: Full-text search, log analysis, and knowledge base indexing.

shell._security: DEVELOPMENT ONLY — restrict to project directory. Never enable in production.
shell._description: Execute shell commands for local build, test, and system introspection (internal RAG).
shell._review: no published distribution found on 2026-11-22 (it is not a published package; the vendor-neutral shell servers are community code with no official source); kept for reference
shell._note: Not a published package. Do not use; run shell commands through your agent's own tools.

openapi._description: Load and query any OpenAPI/Swagger specification for API exploration.

knowledge-graph-memory._description: Persistent knowledge-graph memory (Anthropic) — semantic network so multi-agent systems don't lose/hallucinate architectural decisions. Pairs with core/knowledge-connect.skill.

mcp-evals._description: Evaluate agent/LLM outputs in CI (LLM-as-judge / regression). Pairs with coding/eval-driven-development.skill + agents/scripts/eval_skills.py.

mcp-chaos-rig._description: Chaos engineering for MCP/agents — inject auth failures, disappearing tools, token expiry. Pairs with coding/chaos-fault-injection.skill + 'gabbe verify --chaos'.

supabase._description: Direct DB execution — inspect schemas + run queries against the live Supabase project.

pagerduty._description: On-call automation — incidents, rotations, resolution workflows. Day-2 (S11 Operate & Maintain).
pagerduty._note: PagerDuty hosted server with OAuth (EU accounts: https://mcp.eu.pagerduty.com/mcp). The local uvx server is deprecated.

cloudflare._description: Edge deployment logs, runtime errors, DNS/cache management.

obsidian._description: Knowledge base / ADR + spec search over an Obsidian vault (design & requirements).

discord._description: Communication triage — summarize channels, pull engineering context.

google-genai-toolbox._description: Google MCP Toolbox for Databases (genai-toolbox) — foundational data access; self-hosted Go binary.
google-genai-toolbox._install: Local: download the genai-toolbox (MCP Toolbox for Databases) Go binary from its GitHub releases; run `toolbox --stdio`.

_security_rules.prod_databases: Read-only access only — use dedicated read-only DB user
_security_rules.dev_databases: Read-write allowed — never point dev config at production DB
_security_rules.secrets_policy: All credentials via environment variables — never hardcoded in this file
_security_rules.file_system: Restrict to project directory only — no access to /etc, /home, system dirs
_security_rules.kubernetes_prod: Read-only mode only — no exec, no delete, no scale in production
_security_rules.browser_ci: Headless mode only for CI — headed mode for local debugging only

_environment_variables_required: GITHUB_TOKEN — GitHub Personal Access Token with repo scope
SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN — from Sentry Settings > API Keys (optional)
